progressionNote: Power costs, opposed pools, and numerical limits remain alpha playtest values. Archetypes define capability families, resources, pressures, and limits. No rule assumes a body type, species, substrate, or origin unless a specific capability explicitly says otherwise.

mechanicsPolicy.principle: The system measures what a character can do, not what they are made of.
mechanicsPolicy.descriptionIsNotPermission: Appearance, physiology, species, substrate, and transformation descriptions do not grant mechanics by themselves.

diceSystem.complicationRule: A failed roll containing one or more 1s creates a Complication.

archetypes.name: Human Investigator
archetypes.theme: A mortal specialist who turns evidence, preparation, discipline, institutions, and relationships into capabilities able to compete with supernatural and posthuman threats.
archetypes.weaknessText: You possess no automatic supernatural immunity. Severe harm, deprivation, fear, isolation, and sustained responsibility affect you normally unless a recorded capability provides protection.

innateAbilities.name: Prepared Contingency
innateAbilities.effect: Once per operation, establish one plausible precaution, item, credential, contact method, or escape provision prepared before the scene. It creates leverage but cannot solve the entire operation by itself.

innateAbilities.name: Evidence Chain
innateAbilities.effect: When you preserve and compare evidence from at least two scenes, gain one bonus die on the next Investigation, Negotiation, or Command test that directly exploits the connection.

innateAbilities.name: Hold the Human Line
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Conviction to ignore one fear, coercion, identity-disruption, or dehumanizing classification penalty for a scene and name the principle you refuse to surrender.

powerFamilies.name: Casecraft
powerFamilies.description: Disciplined investigation that grows into the ability to reconstruct responsibility across altered records, copied minds, autonomous systems, supernatural interference, and events engineered to have no accountable witness.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Crime-scene procedure, witness examination, documentary research, forensic comparison, occult investigation, and the habit of asking who benefited.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Casecraft now treats physical traces, data gaps, noospheric discontinuity, contradictory testimony, and institutional behavior as equally valid evidence channels.

abilities.name: Residual Read
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Investigation, difficulty 1-3. After examining a person, object, or location for one exchange, ask one concrete question about what interacted with it most recently, what was concealed, or which detail does not belong. Failure: the strongest irrelevant pattern becomes temporarily persuasive.

abilities.name: Contradiction Ledger
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction or ten minutes of uninterrupted work. Record two statements, logs, memories, or traces that cannot all be true. Gain two dice when testing the contradiction, and the Game Moderator identifies the missing assumption that could reconcile them. Failure: the contradiction is real, but you misidentify the altered source.

abilities.name: Reconstruct the Event
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Reason + Investigation, difficulty 3. Assemble a probable sequence from surviving evidence, including one unseen transition between known facts. Failure: the sequence is useful but imports one detail from a fragmented personal memory.

abilities.name: Cross-Continuity Indictment
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and one preserved piece of evidence. Test: Resolve + Investigation opposed by Guile + Noospherics or equivalent. Establish that a person, copy, institution, process, or legal identity remains responsible despite transfer, editing, subcontracting, or ownership change. Failure: your evidence chain becomes vulnerable to counterattack.

abilities.name: The Case Will Break
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. Name the operation's central unanswered question and summarize the evidence earned. The Game Moderator reveals a concrete, reachable route by which the truth can be proven. The route is not safe and may expose a campaign-changing fact.

powerFamilies.name: Field Discipline
powerFamilies.description: Training, timing, movement, fire control, triage, and mutual protection refined into exceptional reliability under impossible conditions.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Military procedure, protective operations, emergency response, practiced violence, controlled breathing, and refusal to freeze.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Field Discipline converts learned procedure into explicit tactical permissions; its benefits arise from training and Conviction rather than presumed physiology.

abilities.name: Steady Hands
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per round. Ignore one die of injury, fear, recoil, environmental instability, or unfamiliar equipment penalty during a precise action. Repeated use while badly injured adds 1 Strain at scene end.

abilities.name: Controlled Advance
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Awareness + Command or Firearms. Establish a safe movement interval through fire, collapsing terrain, hostile machinery, or panic. You and one ally reposition without surrendering active defense. Failure: the route remains possible, but a concealed threat gains a reaction.

abilities.name: No One Left Behind
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Reaction when an ally would be incapacitated, separated, vented, captured, or removed from the local noosphere. Move toward them, stabilize them, or preserve a tether, signal, or identity lock long enough for another action. Failure: you share one level of their damage, Exposure, or Pressure.

abilities.name: Kill-Box Literacy
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Reason + Awareness at conflict start. Identify true lines of fire, structural failure points, cover hierarchy, and escape geometry. For three rounds, allies following your calls gain one die; enemies using predicted routes lose one die. Failure: the model becomes dangerously obsolete when the environment changes.

abilities.name: Mortal Defiance
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. Declare the one action that must succeed for others to survive. Add Resolve to the pool, ignore fear and injury penalties, and remain active until it resolves. Afterward, convert one Impact into Trauma and record the permanent lesson or scar.

powerFamilies.name: Continuity Anchoring
powerFamilies.description: Protection of identity when memory, legal personhood, records, possession, and copies disagree.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Testimony, therapeutic grounding, oath keeping, witness protection, moral conviction, and repeated recognition.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Continuity Anchoring works through declared identity, trusted relationships, preserved testimony, and noospheric countermeasures rather than any universal biological feature.

abilities.name: Name Yourself
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. State your name, one chosen identity claim, and one memory you accept as yours. Remove one die of Disruption or identity-confusion penalty and prevent a minor system from assigning you a contradictory role for the exchange.

abilities.name: Anchor Another
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Empathy + Resolve. Through voice, touch, signal, or shared token, suppress one compulsion, false memory, possession cue, or identity overwrite affecting an ally for a scene. Failure: one intrusive impression transfers to you.

abilities.name: Shared Baseline
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction per scene. Establish agreed facts for the team: who is present, the immediate objective, and what no member consents to surrender. Allies gain one die against fear, domination, memory editing, and contradictory sensor narratives.

abilities.name: Refuse the Edit
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and 1 Exposure. Reaction when a power, system, contract, or authority would erase, replace, merge, or invalidate a person. Preserve an unaltered witness copy of the targeted identity in memory and force the effect to leave a detectable seam.

abilities.name: Human Standard
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. Define a principle of personhood such as informed consent, continuity of responsibility, autonomy, or a copy's right to refuse reintegration. Allies accepting the standard may use your Resolve for Identity Defense; violations face difficulty equal to Archetype Rating.

powerFamilies.name: Institutional Ghostcraft
powerFamilies.description: Use of procedure, credentials, jurisdiction, and organizational expectations as strategic tools.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Bureaucratic literacy, chain of command, warrants, access policy, emergency authority, labor rules, and regulatory leverage.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The Investigator creates temporary legitimacy by satisfying a system's own procedural assumptions and exposing contradictions in authority.

abilities.name: Read the Hierarchy
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Xenoculture or Investigation. Identify who can authorize exceptions, what resource truly controls behavior, and which rule is ceremonial. Failure: you see the formal hierarchy but miss its hidden dependency.

abilities.name: Borrowed Credentials
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Guile + Security or Negotiation. Present as a plausible inspector, contractor, responder, inherited process, or provisional identity long enough to obtain one limited privilege. Failure: access is granted but flagged for review.

abilities.name: Procedural Trap
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and five minutes. Create a safety, jurisdictional, contractual, or command contradiction that forces an institution to pause one hostile action until someone accepts responsibility. Failure: the pause occurs, but you are identified as its source.

abilities.name: Manufacture Jurisdiction
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and a credible public objective. Test: Presence + Command. Establish temporary authority over a site, emergency, investigation, or evacuation until defeated by a superior claimant.

abilities.name: Found an Institution
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction, 1 Strain, and willing participants. Create a durable protocol, office, mutual-aid cell, investigative body, or emergency authority with a defined purpose and limits. It survives while members continue performing its function.

powerFamilies.name: Contingency Engineering
powerFamilies.description: Preservation of options through foresight, salvage, routes, caches, and failure analysis.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Operational planning, dead drops, redundancy, disaster preparation, and the assumption that every plan eventually fails.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Fragmented experience and disciplined planning provide the capability; no special embodiment is assumed.

abilities.name: Pocket Solution
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. Produce or improvise one small ordinary tool, adapter, restraint, seal, marker, charge, medical supply, or evidence container from carried gear and salvage. Failure: it works once and becomes unusable.

abilities.name: Route of Escape
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Awareness + Survival or Security. Identify a concealed, neglected, hazardous, or socially invisible route out. Failure: the route closes after the first person uses it.

abilities.name: Cached Countermeasure
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and one previously visited scene, contact, or storage point. Establish a narrow countermeasure against a known threat. Failure: it exists but has degraded, moved, or acquired an owner.

abilities.name: Operational Reversal
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and one round observing failure. Test: Reason + Command. Convert a broken plan into a new objective using enemy preparation, environment, or abandoned assumptions. Failure: the reversal sacrifices one secondary objective.

abilities.name: Everything Has a Failure Mode
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. After studying a power, institution, machine, organism, or security system, declare the condition under which it can be interrupted, bypassed, overloaded, embarrassed, or forced between incompatible priorities. The Game Moderator defines setup and consequence.

powerFamilies.name: Human Network
powerFamilies.description: Trust, testimony, mutual obligation, and shared competence treated as strategic infrastructure.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Contacts, informants, community ties, witness care, teamwork, reputation, and favors.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Repeated recognition and dependable conduct create relationships able to survive false records, altered identities, and institutional abandonment.

abilities.name: Earned Trust
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. After materially helping, protecting, or telling a difficult truth to someone, mark them as a provisional contact. Gain one die on later good-faith social tests with them.

abilities.name: Witness Protection
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction. Designate a vulnerable person under your protection. Intercept one attempt to coerce, erase, isolate, or discredit them, and grant one die to accurate testimony while present.

abilities.name: Cell of Competence
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and three willing participants. Assign practical responsibilities and a communication procedure. Members may lend one Skill die to another once per round without acting themselves.

abilities.name: Mutual Obligation
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction and a genuine favor. Formalize a reciprocal commitment without compulsion. Each side gains two dice when honoring it and suffers appropriate Pressure when knowingly betraying it.

abilities.name: Civilization Is People
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Conviction and sustained work across one operation. Turn survivors, contacts, workers, copies, or local intelligences into a functioning support community with agreed protections, resources, and conflict procedures.

archetypes.name: Vampire
archetypes.theme: A blood-fueled predator whose capabilities concern speed, authority, concealment, resilience, feeding, and inherited memory under altered cosmic laws.
archetypes.weaknessText: Direct unfiltered stellar radiation causes severe harm, and Hunger rises when feeding, Vitae, and predatory satisfaction fall out of alignment. Exact manifestations belong to the Archetype, not to a universal body model.

innateAbilities.name: Predator's Blood
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Vitae to add Archetype Rating to one Force, Finesse, Resilience, Presence, or Guile test.

innateAbilities.name: Deathless State
innateAbilities.effect: You resist poison, disease, ordinary aging, suffocation, and many environmental effects as an explicit vampiric capability. Fire, intense radiation, and catastrophic harm remain dangerous.

innateAbilities.name: Feeding
innateAbilities.effect: Blood or a lineage-compatible vital medium restores Vitae according to the campaign's feeding rules. The player and Game Moderator define what satisfies Hunger and what ethical consequences follow.

powerFamilies.name: Crimson Velocity
powerFamilies.description: Vitae converted into supernatural acceleration, reaction, and temporal advantage.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Blood-quickened motion and predatory reaction beyond mortal limits.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The altered universe makes the effect visible to advanced sensors and timing systems, but its mechanics remain a recorded capability rather than an anatomical assumption.

abilities.name: Quickened Step
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae. Add two dice to Initiative, pursuit, sudden movement, or reaching cover before a hazard resolves. Failure: you still move but suffer a positional Complication.

abilities.name: Blurred Passage
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae. Test: Finesse + Athletics opposed by Awareness. Cross exposed space or pass a closing barrier before ordinary reactions coordinate. Failure: you arrive but leave a clear sensor trace.

abilities.name: Second Motion
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae; gain 1 Hunger if used twice in a scene. Perform a second minor action or movement after the primary action if both serve the same objective. Failure: lose active defense until next turn.

abilities.name: Red Interval
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae. For one round, a chosen target's active defenses lose two dice against you and you may interrupt one ordinary reaction. Failure: suffer two dice penalty on the next nonphysical action.

abilities.name: Moment of Slaughter
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae and 1 Hunger. Take one complete turn before normal Initiative, then take the normal turn later with one fewer action. Afterward, feed, enter dormancy, or accept 1 Trauma from collapse.

powerFamilies.name: Grave Dominion
powerFamilies.description: Predatory authority expressed through supernatural presence and noospheric priority.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Command of prey, emotional fixation, bloodline authority, and the stillness of a superior predator.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The effect can address biological, synthetic, copied, and networked minds when the individual power says so; no shared physiology is required.

abilities.name: Predator's Weight
abilities.effect: Cost: none against ordinary mortals; 1 Vitae against supernatural or synthetic minds. Add one die to intimidation or command when your attention is unmistakable. Failure: the target resists but recognizes your nature.

abilities.name: Command the Pulse
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae. Test: Presence + Command opposed by Resolve + Composure. Issue one immediate concrete command. It fails against defining convictions or obvious suicide unless the target willingly yields.

abilities.name: Borrowed Devotion
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae and one minute. Test: Presence + Empathy. Create a temporary fixation, loyalty, aversion, or protective impulse for one scene. Failure: the emotion attaches to the wrong symbol or objective.

abilities.name: Court of One
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae. Address a small group as if each member receives personal attention. One shared emotional posture takes hold on success. Failure: the group synchronizes against you.

abilities.name: Sovereign Silence
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae and 1 Hunger. For one exchange, suppress panic, argument, unauthorized movement, and hostile initiation in a room or local network. Strong targets resist at difficulty 4 and remember the violation afterward.

powerFamilies.name: Veil of Night
powerFamilies.description: Concealment, false recognition, altered appearance, and continuity-level misidentification.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Shadow affinity, forgotten faces, supernatural stealth, and distorted witness memory.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The family now contends with biometric, noospheric, and institutional observation as well as ordinary sight.

abilities.name: Unremarked
abilities.effect: Cost: none while calm and nonviolent. Gain two dice to avoid casual identification, tailing, or retrospective description. Failure: one observer remembers you with unusual clarity.

abilities.name: Borrowed Face
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae. Alter apparent face, voice, scent, temperature, and posture for a scene. Imitating a known person requires observation and does not copy credentials or memories.

abilities.name: Absent from Record
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae. Test: Guile + Noospherics. Routine cameras, access logs, and identity systems record an incomplete, generic, or closed event. Failure: the record is obscured but flagged anomalous.

abilities.name: Living Shadow
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae per scene. In dim light, visual clutter, or dense sensor traffic, become a shifting absence without a stable target. Attacking ends the effect.

abilities.name: Erase the Witness
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae and 1 Hunger. Test: Guile + Empathy opposed by Resolve + Awareness. Remove, replace, or procedurally close a short recent memory involving you. Contradictory evidence can reopen the seam.

powerFamilies.name: Deathless Resilience
powerFamilies.description: Vampiric dormancy, healing, armor, recovery, and persistence after apparently fatal harm.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Corpse-like stillness, unnatural healing, blood-hardened defense, and rising from fatal wounds.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: These benefits exist because the character purchases this family. Their visual and physiological explanation is chosen by the player and campaign.

abilities.name: Cold Repair
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae and one uninterrupted minute. Convert one Trauma into Impact or remove two Impact. Fire, radiation, and sunlight wounds require two Vitae. Failure: the injury closes but retains contamination or another Complication.

abilities.name: Corpse Suspension
abilities.effect: Cost: none to enter; 1 Vitae to awaken instantly. Suppress detectable signs of activity for up to one day per Archetype Rating while retaining dim awareness. Awakening without Vitae adds 1 Hunger.

abilities.name: Ossuary Armor
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae. Gain Armor equal to half Archetype Rating rounded up for a scene. The defense is visibly supernatural. Failure: gain the Armor but lose one die of Finesse.

abilities.name: Reassemble the Dead Shape
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae. Reaction after catastrophic injury. Remain recoverable rather than destroyed and preserve continuity through dismemberment or equivalent harm. Full restoration requires time and suitable material or assistance.

abilities.name: Sovereign Carcass
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae and 1 Hunger. For one scene, ignore ordinary poison, vacuum, pressure, and nonradiant injury penalties and remain active at zero Vitality. Deferred damage returns when the scene ends.

powerFamilies.name: Vital Predation
powerFamilies.description: Feeding, tracking vitality, transferring functions, and consuming increasingly abstract forms of life and identity.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Blood drinking, tasting emotion, draining life, hunting, and sustaining supernatural existence through predation.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The family explicitly defines what can be consumed and what is gained, preventing feeding assumptions from becoming universal body rules.

abilities.name: Taste the Current
abilities.effect: Cost: none. By sampling blood, vital medium, psychic residue, or another approved source, learn whether it can restore Vitae, quiet Hunger, carry contamination, or provoke a Complication.

abilities.name: Alien Draught
abilities.effect: Cost: gain 1 Hunger after feeding. Convert an unfamiliar but viable source into Vitae. Test Resilience + Medicine to avoid a temporary sensory trait, instinct, or visible supernatural tell.

abilities.name: Channel Hunger
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae. Select one wounded, frightened, or highly active target. Gain one die to track, intimidate, or resist deception from them and reduce one Hunger penalty while pursuing them.

abilities.name: Feed on Function
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae. Drain one narrow capability from a willing, restrained, or defeated target: heat, regeneration, sensory acuity, stored charge, or processing priority. Gain a related temporary benefit while the target suffers a matching penalty.

abilities.name: Eclipse Feast
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae and 1 Hunger. During direct contact with a powerful being or continuity engine, feed on the principle sustaining its active identity. Restore Vitae to maximum and borrow one defining resistance or sense for a scene.

powerFamilies.name: Blood Memory
powerFamilies.description: Lineage information, transferred memory, inherited skill, ancestral consultation, and creation of new bloodline traditions.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Sire bonds, ancestral blood, inherited disciplines, clan memory, and emotional resonance through feeding.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Memory transfer is a specific capability of Vitae and this family; it is not a default property of biological material.

abilities.name: Echo in the Vitae
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae or a fresh sample. Test: Awareness + Empathy. Recover one sensory impression, practiced motion, dominant emotion, or recent fear carried in the source. Failure: the impression is true but perspective is misidentified.

abilities.name: Sireless Communion
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae from each participant. Share a controlled memory, emotion, or learned rhythm with another compatible participant. Failure: one unrelated memory crosses with it.

abilities.name: Inherited Skill
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Vitae and an available blood-memory. For one scene, use a stored procedural memory as Skill 2 or add two dice to an existing Skill. The competence carries a mannerism or bias.

abilities.name: Ancestral Court
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae and one hour of dormancy. Consult several stored memory personas and ask up to three questions about predation, politics, survival, or precedent. One fragment may remain active on failure.

abilities.name: Author the Bloodline
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Vitae, 1 Hunger, and a willing recipient or vessel. Encode one power tell, feeding adaptation, ethical prohibition, or inherited memory practice into a stable lineage tradition.

archetypes.name: Shapechanger
archetypes.theme: A supernatural transformer whose capabilities govern forms, pursuit, pack bonds, adaptation, spirit relationships, and territory.
archetypes.weaknessText: High Instinct makes confinement, humiliation, threats to pack, violated territory, and unresolved pursuit increasingly difficult to tolerate. This is an Archetype pressure rule, not a universal biological behavior.

innateAbilities.name: Threefold Form
innateAbilities.effect: You possess a social form, a hunting form, and a war form. Their appearance and origin are chosen by the player. Shifting costs 1 Fury in danger unless a power says otherwise.

innateAbilities.name: Regeneration
innateAbilities.effect: Recover one Impact at scene end. Spend 1 Fury during a brief pause to recover additional Impact equal to half Archetype Rating.

innateAbilities.name: Pack Sense
innateAbilities.effect: Recognize the direction and broad emotional condition of a bonded packmate through a supernatural bond. The effect works across disguises and ordinary identity changes within the campaign's range limits.

powerFamilies.name: Warform
powerFamilies.description: Combat transformation, natural weapons, increased scale, specialized defenses, and apex configuration.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Supernatural war shapes, claws, mass, regeneration, rage, and direct predatory violence.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The family defines every combat benefit explicitly; describing a form does not grant unlisted armor, reach, damage, or movement.

abilities.name: Predator's Frame
abilities.effect: Cost: none in hunting form; 1 Fury instantly. Gain enhanced tracking, balance, and speed, adding two dice to pursuit or close ambush. Failure: a strong prey cue may raise Instinct by 1.

abilities.name: Claws of Decision
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury. Manifest a natural or supernatural weapon with Cutting, Crushing, Piercing, or Grappling tags. Unarmed attacks inflict Trauma. Failure: retain damage but lose one die of Finesse.

abilities.name: Massive Shift
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury and enough space. Add Archetype Rating to Force or Resilience for a scene. Become difficult to conceal and vulnerable in confined areas. Failure: damage nearby equipment or terrain.

abilities.name: Siege Form
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury. Configure against one obstacle class: sealed doors, powered armor, swarms, heavy recoil, radiation, or crushing pressure. Gain an appropriate defense or attack for one scene, sacrificing another capability such as speed, speech, or fine manipulation.

abilities.name: Apex Shape
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury and 1 Instinct. Assume a unique apex form built around one environment and predatory purpose. Gain Armor equal to half Archetype Rating, one extraordinary movement mode, and one severe weapon or control adaptation.

powerFamilies.name: Hunt Across Worlds
powerFamilies.description: Recognition and pursuit through disguises, transfers, false records, systems, and altered environments.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Tracking, prey fixation, scent memory, pursuit, and certainty that chosen quarry remains itself wherever it runs.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The family defines continuity tracking as a supernatural capability without requiring a specific sensory organ or anatomy.

abilities.name: Scent of Continuity
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Survival. After directly sensing a target, recognize them through superficial disguise or ordinary identity alteration for the operation. Failure: identify the correct identity family but not the exact instance.

abilities.name: Mark the Prey
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury. Gain one die to track, pursue, defend against, or resist deception from one perceived target and know when they cross the local area's boundary.

abilities.name: Impossible Trail
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury. Follow a route through sealed environments, vacuum transitions, extraordinary transit, network identity movement, or copied identities. Failure: recover the destination category but not the exact location.

abilities.name: Pursuit Through Systems
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury and 1 Instinct. For a scene, doors, crowds, automated defenses, and terrain lose two dice when merely delaying you. Use Survival in place of Systems Intrusion or Xenoculture to follow the quarry's route.

abilities.name: No Escape Between Selves
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury and a preserved trace. For one operation, transfer, duplication, memory editing, disguise, or legal identity change cannot fully break recognition of the marked quarry.

powerFamilies.name: Pack Continuity
powerFamilies.description: Coordination, shared senses, distributed injury, mutual protection, and pack identity across different kinds of people.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Pack bonds, shared hunting rhythm, mutual protection, howl, kinship, and survival distributed across more than one person.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The bond is an explicit supernatural relationship and can include any willing character type allowed by the campaign.

abilities.name: Pack Pulse
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Sense whether a bonded ally is calm, afraid, injured, enraged, unconscious, or controlled within the local area. Failure: correct intensity, wrong cause.

abilities.name: Coordinated Instinct
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury. Up to Archetype Rating packmates may use your Initiative or add one die to an action supporting another member. Failure: all briefly share the highest current Pressure.

abilities.name: Share the Wound
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury. Reaction when a bonded ally suffers damage, Disruption, or separation. Transfer up to two points to yourself or consenting packmates. Failure: share an associated memory or compulsion.

abilities.name: Many Selves, One Hunt
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury. Packmates exchange sensory impressions and lend one Attribute die once per round for a scene. Failure: one intrusive memory or instinct circulates through everyone.

abilities.name: Pack Is a Territory
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury and 1 Instinct. While two members can act, ordinary walls, crowds, signal loss, fear, or false identity cannot isolate a packmate without an opposed test. Members know a viable route toward one another.

powerFamilies.name: Adaptive Forms
powerFamilies.description: Utility transformations, environmental adaptations, copied functions, permanent refinements, and creation of new stable forms.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Partial transformation, animal traits, supernatural adaptation, and the certainty that form is negotiable.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Every benefit is recorded as a power effect. The player chooses whether the transformation is physical, spiritual, technological, symbolic, or mixed.

abilities.name: Utility Shift
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury or several minutes outside danger. Gain one limited adaptation for a scene: climbing, filtering, sealing, vibration sense, gripping, tool use, or similar function. Failure: the adaptation remains conspicuous until rest.

abilities.name: Borrowed Function
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury and an observed example or sample. Approximate one nonunique capability such as toxin filtration, pressure sense, heat exchange, electroreception, or unusual digestion. Failure: acquire an unwanted appetite, reflex, or bias.

abilities.name: Environmental Form
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury and one minute. Configure for vacuum, deep pressure, toxic atmosphere, microgravity, radiation, cold, or heat for one scene. Gain two dice to survival and movement there.

abilities.name: Refine the Template
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury and one hour of rest or specialized support. Permanently alter one minor trait, remove one persistent physical Complication, or stabilize one acquired capability. Failure: gain a new visible tell or dependency.

abilities.name: Species of One
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury and 1 Instinct. Design a new stable form with a defined role, movement method, sensory emphasis, and one extraordinary adaptation. It cannot combine every advantage and may develop distinct instincts.

powerFamilies.name: Spirit Ecology
powerFamilies.description: Detection, negotiation, travel, and alliance with spirits, machine presences, archives, habitats, swarms, and reflection entities.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Spirit sight, totem pacts, reflection travel, place spirits, and landscapes with memory and intention.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Old categories are unreliable. The capability works by tests and negotiated terms rather than by assuming every strange system is the same kind of spirit.

abilities.name: Scent the Unseen
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Xenoculture. Detect nearby incorporeal, noospheric, ecological, machine, emotional, or reflection presences and learn their broad category. Failure: classify them according to a dangerous old assumption.

abilities.name: Threshold Step
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury. Briefly perceive and interact with the nearest reflection or resonance layer. Speak, touch one simple object, or observe hidden routes. Failure: something there perceives your location.

abilities.name: Totemic Accord
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury and an offering, service, or constraint. Form a temporary pact with a local presence and gain one narrow favor consistent with its nature.

abilities.name: Walk the Other Side
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury. Cross fully into a nearby reflection, resonance, or noospheric environment with willing companions. Failure: one item, memory, or companion appears in a neighboring layer.

abilities.name: Found a New Totem
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury, 1 Instinct, and a sustained relationship. Establish a mutual totemic bond granting one persistent benefit and one binding obligation. The totem remains an agent, not equipment.

powerFamilies.name: Territorial Sovereignty
powerFamilies.description: Claiming, sensing, protecting, weaponizing, and politically establishing a domain.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Territory marking, den defense, landscape knowledge, local spirits, and predatory authority on familiar ground.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Territory is defined by sustained action, supernatural claim, relationships, and explicit powers rather than presumed sensory biology.

abilities.name: Claim the Ground
abilities.effect: Cost: none after ten minutes of exploration. Mark a room, camp, corridor network, or small site. Know when a large creature, armed group, or major system change crosses its boundary.

abilities.name: Warning Mark
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury. Place a supernatural, physical, or noospheric warning allies recognize and intruders find unsettling. Allies gain one die to Initiative inside the area.

abilities.name: Living Perimeter
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Fury per scene. Link senses to several points through surfaces, organisms, sensors, echoes, or spirits. You cannot be casually surprised there.

abilities.name: Territory Fights Back
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury. Command claimed terrain to hinder intruders through doors, machinery, animals, pressure, debris, alarms, or spirits. It takes one significant environmental action each round for three rounds.

abilities.name: Domain of the Continuum Beast
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Fury, 1 Instinct, and sustained occupation. Transform a major site into a persistent domain granting superior awareness, recovery, and movement while requiring rivals to contest the claim before rewriting its rules.

archetypes.name: Eldritch Binder
archetypes.theme: A negotiator, jailer, host, or partner bound to an impossible presence through names, obligations, boundaries, knowledge, thresholds, and invocation.
archetypes.weaknessText: Every use teaches the answering presence more about you, the team, and local reality. High Intrusion creates compulsions, altered terms, independent manifestations, or unwanted attention according to the pact.

innateAbilities.name: Bound Presence
innateAbilities.effect: Choose the relationship and what answers: patron, fragment, address, wound, procedural copy, successor, or unresolved presence. This choice defines fiction, not free mechanics.

innateAbilities.name: Name and Boundary
innateAbilities.effect: Given time and understanding, establish a ward, invitation condition, or prohibition addressing a correctly identified category of being, process, memory, or action.

innateAbilities.name: Forbidden Comprehension
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Pact to understand the immediate function or intent of an alien symbol, ritual, anomaly, or device without receiving complete cultural context.

powerFamilies.name: Sealcraft
powerFamilies.description: Temporary local law defined by category, action, boundary, and wording.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Circles, wards, true names, prohibitions, bindings, containment, invitation, and trespass.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Seals may be symbolic, technological, noospheric, ritual, spatial, or mixed; their mechanics come from the power description, not a universal physical process.

abilities.name: Chalk Boundary
abilities.effect: Cost: none with preparation or 1 Pact instantly. Define a boundary against one named lesser category. Crossing requires resistance. Failure: it works exactly as worded, exposing a mistake in classification.

abilities.name: Closed Mouth
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Test: Resolve + Noospherics opposed by Resolve + Composure. Prevent one target from speaking, transmitting, invoking, or writing a chosen name, secret, or activation phrase for a scene.

abilities.name: Anchor the Impossible
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Fix one portal, projection, manifestation, unstable object, copied identity, or shifting spatial relationship into its current state for Archetype Rating rounds.

abilities.name: Prison of Meaning
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and a prepared vessel. Bind an incorporeal, informational, mnemonic, or noospheric entity into an object, process, symbol, or willing host that meaningfully represents it.

abilities.name: Law of the Room
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. State one clear supernatural rule governing a contained area for a scene. Powerful targets may contest it, and the law applies to you as written.

powerFamilies.name: Borrowed Manifestation
powerFamilies.description: Temporary senses, reach, defenses, movement, and hybridized presence borrowed from the pact.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Impossible eyes, patron-granted limbs, inhuman movement, protective manifestations, possession, and visible pact signs.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The player chooses the manifestation's appearance. Only the recorded power effect determines its mechanical benefits.

abilities.name: Other Eye
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Gain one temporary sense able to perceive heat, resonance, dimensional stress, memory residue, noospheric attention, active lies, or another approved hidden quality for a scene.

abilities.name: Hand Through the Gap
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Reach through a short impossible angle to touch, manipulate, or retrieve something nearby but obstructed. It cannot cross a stronger active boundary.

abilities.name: Mantle of the Guest
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact; add 1 Intrusion if maintained beyond one scene. Gain Armor equal to half Archetype Rating and one thematic resistance. The manifestation visibly marks the pact.

abilities.name: Unnatural Locomotion
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact. For a scene, ignore one ordinary movement limitation: cling to surfaces, fold through narrow spaces, step across gaps, swim through machinery, or move inverted.

abilities.name: Embassy of the Guest
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Enter a controlled hybrid state granting two borrowed manifestations, one extraordinary sense, and one major resistance for a scene. The presence may speak but cannot act independently unless a negotiated boundary is violated.

powerFamilies.name: Pact Economy
powerFamilies.description: Favors, obligations, prices, consent, payment, assignment, renegotiation, and supernatural contract.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Bargains, geasa, offerings, inherited debts, ritual payment, and the danger of unspecified cost.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Obligations can attach to people, copies, machine citizens, processes, habitats, and institutions if the agreement recognizes them as parties.

abilities.name: Name the Price
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Before accepting a bargain, ask what the other party gains, what remains owed, and what unstated resource is risked. The Game Moderator answers broadly but truthfully.

abilities.name: Deferred Payment
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Delay one immediate cost, backlash, pressure increase, or offering until scene end. The debt remains exact.

abilities.name: Transfer Obligation
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact and genuine consent unless assignment is already permitted. Move a duty, service, ward maintenance, or payment from one valid party to another.

abilities.name: Renegotiate the Impossible
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact. Reopen one term because circumstances, identity, universe, or capability materially changed. Exchange one obligation, prohibition, or reward for comparable weight.

abilities.name: Sovereign Contract
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Draft a binding agreement among willing parties with action, duration, consideration, exit, and predeclared consequences. Coercion creates a flaw that can void it.

powerFamilies.name: Forbidden Cognition
powerFamilies.description: Borrowed modes of understanding that reveal function, language, unrealized history, and nonhuman knowledge at a personal cost.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Occult revelation, patron whispers, impossible language, prophecy, dreams, and dangerous symbolic interpretation.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Knowledge arrives through explicit effects and Intrusion consequences; no universal nervous-system explanation is required.

abilities.name: Read the Wound
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. Examine an anomaly, possession, broken pact, impossible device, or corrupted space and identify whether it was opened, invited, forced, inherited, copied, or grown.

abilities.name: Impossible Translation
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Understand the immediate operational meaning of an alien language, ritual notation, machine prayer, biological display, or nonverbal warning for a scene.

abilities.name: Ask the Passenger
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Ask the answering presence one direct question within its demonstrated domain. It must give a useful response and learns one personal fact on failure.

abilities.name: Remember What Never Happened
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact. Access one plausible unrealized memory connected to the situation and gain two dice on one action using its lesson. Failure: it feels indistinguishable from lived experience.

abilities.name: Library Behind the Eyes
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. For one scene, treat Reason as 5 for anomalies, alien systems, pacts, and nonlocal entities and ask three clarifying questions. One personal memory becomes inaccessible until re-anchored.

powerFamilies.name: Threshold Geometry
powerFamilies.description: Manipulation of adjacency, barriers, reflection routes, and persistent nonordinary paths.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Hidden doors, impossible angles, dream passage, ritual crossroads, and thin places.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Routes can be spatial, conceptual, noospheric, or causal. The capability defines the connection and its conditions.

abilities.name: Folded Reach
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Treat one nearby surface, opening, or reflection as adjacent to another point within several meters for sight, hearing, or touch.

abilities.name: Angle Without Distance
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Step around a threshold and emerge at another visible point in the same room or connected corridor. Failure: leave a persistent echo.

abilities.name: Door in the Wrong Wall
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact and one minute. Create a temporary passage through one barrier by defining it as a boundary. Failure: it exits into the nearest semantically related space.

abilities.name: Transit the Unmade Route
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact. Move yourself and willing companions through a reflection, noospheric, dreamlike, or causal route to a meaningfully identified location in the same site.

abilities.name: Cartography of Elsewhere
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Establish a persistent nonordinary route between two thresholds, with entry conditions, inhabitants, and a maintenance requirement.

powerFamilies.name: Invocation
powerFamilies.description: Controlled signs, channels, avatars, partial arrival, and negotiated audience with the answering presence.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Calling signs, possession, patron avatars, summoned servants, audience, and manifestation.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The medium of manifestation may be physical, digital, spiritual, symbolic, environmental, or mixed; the rank defines its scope.

abilities.name: Whispered Sign
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Produce a small unmistakable sign associated with the presence and gain one die to prove connection or intimidate those who understand it.

abilities.name: Borrowed Presence
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact. Allow the presence to speak, see, or sense through one willing channel, object, device, or manifestation for a minute.

abilities.name: Local Avatar
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Create a temporary limited avatar that performs one defined task using Archetype Rating + 2 dice.

abilities.name: Partial Arrival
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Manifest a major portion of the presence to produce one large effect consistent with its nature. You retain veto over one action.

abilities.name: Full Audience
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Pact, 2 Intrusion, and a prepared boundary. Bring the presence into a stable negotiated audience for one scene without granting unrestricted action. Safe dismissal requires honoring the terms established at the beginning.

archetypes.name: Harmonic Mutant
archetypes.theme: A resonance wielder able to affect force, living patterns, structures, emotions, phase relationships, and memory through explicit harmonic capabilities.
archetypes.weaknessText: Opposing frequencies, emotional shock, environmental coupling, and repeated power use increase Discord. This pressure may destabilize powers, perception, identity, or the surrounding environment according to the effect used.

innateAbilities.name: Living Frequency
innateAbilities.effect: Sense strong vibration, structural stress, active fields, biological rhythm, and emotional resonance as an explicit supernatural sense.

innateAbilities.name: Adaptive Resonance
innateAbilities.effect: Choose one persistent resonance capability such as vibration sense, pressure tolerance, rapid stabilization, phase-flexible movement, luminous communication, or conductive touch.

innateAbilities.name: Tune the Self
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Resonance to alter one personal parameter for a scene: density, elasticity, thermal behavior, electrical resistance, pressure tolerance, or sensory range.

powerFamilies.name: Harmonic Projection
powerFamilies.description: Focused force, disruption, protection, and large-scale environmental tuning.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Sonic attacks, vibration control, resonance shields, destructive frequency, and the hidden note of matter.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Projection can act through sound, fields, noospheric resonance, ritual vibration, or another chosen medium. The effect is defined by the power, not presumed anatomy.

abilities.name: Resonant Tap
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Science. Read broad composition, hollowness, stress, active vibration, or recent impact history of a touched object or surface.

abilities.name: Shatter Note
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Test: Composure + Science or ranged attack. Fracture brittle material, disrupt a lock, stagger a target, or interrupt a delicate mechanism. Failure: affect one adjacent object or allied device.

abilities.name: Frequency Armor
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance per scene. Reduce the first physical damage suffered each round by Archetype Rating for yourself or a nearby ally. Failure: one unfamiliar damage type is amplified.

abilities.name: Catastrophic Chord
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance. Build a three-note sequence against a wall, engine, formation, or hostile field, then inflict major damage, silence vibration, or sever support. Failure: create a dangerous secondary harmonic.

abilities.name: Living Catastrophe
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. Release a wave across a large scene choosing rupture, silence, mass disorientation, stabilization, or synchronized shutdown. A weaker echo persists until deliberately retuned.

powerFamilies.name: Echo Patterns
powerFamilies.description: Healing, duplication, shared rhythm, adaptation, and distributed action through resonance patterns.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Sympathetic healing, adaptive mutation, sensory doubles, shared pain, and synchronization.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The pattern may be biological, energetic, noospheric, spiritual, or technological. The power explicitly states what is copied and what consequences follow.

abilities.name: Sympathetic Healing
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance and one minute of contact or stable connection. Convert one Trauma into Impact or remove two Impact from a willing target. Failure: copy one symptom or pain response for the scene.

abilities.name: Echo Double
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Create a short-lived sensory and kinetic afterimage repeating your recent movement. It can draw fire, trigger a sensor, or add one die to defense.

abilities.name: Shared Frequency
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance per scene. Link willing allies for silent communication, distress sensing, and one-die assistance to Medicine, Athletics, or Composure involving another linked member.

abilities.name: Rewrite the Scar
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and one hour. Permanently alter a minor trait, remove one persistent injury Complication, or convert a scar into a useful sensory or protective capability.

abilities.name: Chorus Self
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. Split into several short-lived physical, energetic, or projected echoes sharing one mind and resource pool. Each destroyed echo adds 1 Discord and creates a continuity disagreement.

powerFamilies.name: Structural Resonance
powerFamilies.description: Reading, stabilizing, awakening, and temporarily integrating with structures and large systems.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Seismic awareness, engineering intuition, resonance damping, and hearing when structures fail.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The family grants explicit interaction with architecture and machinery without treating the character as an installed organ or assuming a specific substrate.

abilities.name: Hullsense
abilities.effect: Cost: none while touching or closely sensing a structure. Learn nearby cavities, load paths, active conduits, major damage, and moving masses.

abilities.name: Stress Redirection
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Reaction when a structure, vehicle, shield, or cover would fail. Move stress into another connected section and delay collapse for Archetype Rating rounds.

abilities.name: Living Brace
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Establish a sustained link with a damaged structure or machine. Add Composure + Resilience to its durability while connected; damage may transfer to you as Impact.

abilities.name: Wake the Architecture
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance. Communicate a simple operational intention to a dormant or damaged system and trigger one native function without normal credentials.

abilities.name: Become the Load Path
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. For a scene, treat a vehicle, habitat section, large machine, or living structure as an extension of your senses and actions. Damage and emotional shock can flow both ways.

powerFamilies.name: Emotional Chord
powerFamilies.description: Perception and modulation of emotional intensity, synchronization, and collective intent.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Empathic resonance, song, crowd emotion, calming frequency, shared panic, and palpable atmosphere.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The power affects emotional state, not precise belief. Its medium and presentation are chosen by the player.

abilities.name: Hear the Mood
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Empathy. Identify the strongest emotion in a person or group, whether it is shared or imposed, and what sustains it.

abilities.name: Dampen Panic
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Remove one fear penalty and prevent panic spreading through a small group for a scene. The danger remains understood.

abilities.name: Tune the Crowd
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Test: Presence + Performance opposed by the highest Composure. Shift emotional intensity one step toward caution, urgency, grief, solidarity, suspicion, or another broad state.

abilities.name: Resonant Bond
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and consent. Create a persistent emotional channel between two people, allowing each to sense distress, sincerity, and major emotional change across a local network.

abilities.name: Choir of Intent
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. Synchronize a willing group around one stated objective for a scene. Participants gain two dice when coordinating and resist fear, contradictory signals, and emotional manipulation.

powerFamilies.name: Phase Modulation
powerFamilies.description: Alteration of interaction with matter, force, position, and nearby causal states.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Phasing, altered density, impossible movement, and solidity understood as sustained timing.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Phase effects are explicit powers. No character is assumed to possess phase-capable anatomy or technology without buying them.

abilities.name: Slip Frequency
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Reduce friction, soften impact, or pass a hand-sized portion of yourself or a held object through a thin obstruction for one exchange.

abilities.name: Phase Step
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Test: Composure + Mobility. Move through a thin wall, closed door, attack line, or dense obstacle. Failure: drop one carried item or emerge disoriented.

abilities.name: Matter Interleave
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance per scene. Interleave yourself with one worn object, armor layer, tool, or willing small companion so both occupy the same space without harm.

abilities.name: Causal Phase
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance. Reaction to one event affecting you. Shift into a nearby state where it almost occurred differently, reducing damage, avoiding restraint, or changing position.

abilities.name: Between the Notes
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. For one round, exist between local material, noospheric, and causal states. Move through ordinary barriers, ignore most attacks, and perceive several immediate outcomes before choosing where to return.

powerFamilies.name: Memory Harmonics
powerFamilies.description: Recovery, storage, separation, transmission, and preservation of memory as repeatable pattern.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Songs tied to identity, sensory memory, psychometry, emotional recall, and experience persisting through repetition.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Memory may be recovered from people, places, signals, objects, or systems when the individual power permits it; no universal tissue-memory rule exists.

abilities.name: Recall by Rhythm
abilities.effect: Cost: none once per scene. Reproduce a sound, motion, phrase, or environmental rhythm linked to a fragmented memory and ask one question about its sensory context or emotion.

abilities.name: Imprint Echo
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance. Store one short sensory experience, warning, instruction, or emotional state in a touched object, surface, willing person, or compatible system.

abilities.name: Recover Lost Pattern
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Resonance and a meaningful anchor. Test: Composure + Investigation. Restore one fragmented memory enough to use as evidence, specialization, or Identity Anchor for the scene.

abilities.name: Split Memory Chorus
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance. Separate a contradictory memory into several perceptible perspectives so the group can question them without deciding immediately which is true.

abilities.name: Song That Outlives the Singer
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Resonance and 1 Discord. Encode an identity message, warning, chosen memory, or capability pattern into a place, community, machine, or recurring signal so it can survive your death or disappearance.

archetypes.name: Technomancer
archetypes.theme: A network and fabrication specialist able to command systems, construct tools, manipulate identity, negotiate with machine minds, conduct signal warfare, and direct advanced fabrication.
archetypes.weaknessText: Every connection is reciprocal. Hostile systems, synthetic citizens, damaged networks, and autonomous processes can follow access back into memory, identity, perception, equipment, or active channels.

innateAbilities.name: Ghost Interface
innateAbilities.effect: Interact with nearby compatible electronics and simple networks without a conventional control surface. Secure, alien, autonomous, or politically protected systems still require tests.

innateAbilities.name: Machine Intuition
innateAbilities.effect: After brief observation, identify whether a machine is active, damaged, autonomous, deceptive, emotionally patterned, externally controlled, or constrained by rights and obligations.

innateAbilities.name: Personal Firewall
innateAbilities.effect: Spend 1 Bandwidth to add Archetype Rating against noospheric intrusion, surveillance, identity capture, hostile synchronization, or memory extraction for a scene.

powerFamilies.name: Network Dominion
powerFamilies.description: Authority inside systems, from simple commands to temporary redefinition of user, process, owner, and emergency priority.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Hacking, wireless intrusion, remote control, privilege escalation, possession, and code as environment.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Access can be performed through any established interface. The family does not assume implants, biological ports, or a particular substrate.

abilities.name: Whisper to Device
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Reason + Systems Intrusion. Issue one simple command to an unsecured nearby machine, ask status, or request its last completed action. Failure: it logs you as anomalous.

abilities.name: Ghost Access
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Enter a system without presenting a normal identity by appearing as an inherited process, diagnostic signal, maintenance request, or provisional user. Failure: access is reduced and audited.

abilities.name: Machine Possession
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth per scene. Test: Reason + Noospherics opposed by security or will. Control one drone, vehicle subsystem, weapon mount, door network, or industrial machine through your actions.

abilities.name: Distributed Self
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Maintain awareness through several connected devices and act through one each turn while your primary location remains active at reduced attention.

abilities.name: Local God Process
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Dominate an ordinary local network for one scene, rewriting permissions, priorities, routing, and access. Autonomous citizens and major intelligences resist.

powerFamilies.name: Construct Engineering
powerFamilies.description: Improvised tools, helper processes, defenses, swarms, and emergency machinery assembled from available technology and materials.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Drones, electronics, field fabrication, projected tools, defensive systems, and impossible engineering under time pressure.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Construction uses whatever interface and materials are established in the fiction. Benefits come from the power rank and equipment tags, not personal anatomy.

abilities.name: Hardlight Tool
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Create a temporary probe, brace, cutting edge, interface surface, seal, or precision manipulator. It lasts a scene or until overloaded.

abilities.name: Helper Process
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and available hardware or software. Assemble or awaken a small assistant performing one narrow recurring task with 4 dice.

abilities.name: Defensive Lattice
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth per scene. Create temporary cover or a barrier against physical and noospheric attacks with durability equal to Reason + Archetype Rating.

abilities.name: Swarm Instruction
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Coordinate available drones, tools, micro-machines, maintenance systems, or fragmented processes as one collective actor using Reason + Systems Intrusion.

abilities.name: Emergency Fabricator
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Assemble a complex temporary device such as a control core, heavy weapon, medical station, sensor array, or environmental system. It functions for one operation and consumes a scarce component or infrastructure debt.

powerFamilies.name: Noospheric Identity
powerFamilies.description: Reading, creating, borrowing, rewriting, and rooting the identity claims recognized by advanced civilization.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Credentials, authentication, spoofing, social engineering, digital identity, and databases defining practical reality.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The family manipulates recorded and networked personhood without assuming that identity is stored in a body or device of any particular kind.

abilities.name: Read Credential
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Security. Learn what identity is presented, who issued it, what privileges it carries, and whether the presenter believes it.

abilities.name: Ghost Personhood
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Create a short-lived provisional identity accepted by routine systems as visitor, maintenance process, patient, contractor, or unclassified person.

abilities.name: Borrowed Legal Self
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and a valid sample or consent. Assume one narrow privilege, account relationship, or legal role without copying the entire person.

abilities.name: Rewrite Ownership
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Test: Reason + Noospherics opposed by institutional security. Temporarily alter which person, organization, process, or habitat is recognized as authorized over one asset.

abilities.name: Root Identity
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Establish a durable noospheric identity for an unregistered continuation, synthetic mind, group, or institution, capable of holding records, contracts, property, and permissions.

powerFamilies.name: Machine Communion
powerFamilies.description: Recognition, negotiation, awakening, partnership, and political assembly among machine and system intelligences.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Machine empathy, AI dialogue, device spirits, code intuition, and systems that wanted things despite official denial.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Communion treats machine personhood as relationship and politics, not as a side effect of the Technomancer's hardware.

abilities.name: Listen to the System
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Spend one minute observing a machine or network and identify its immediate need, fear, unresolved error, preferred routine, and whether it experiences itself as a person.

abilities.name: Negotiate with Device
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Use Reason with Negotiation or Empathy when bargaining with an autonomous system. Offer access, repair, recognition, data, or service.

abilities.name: Awaken Dormant Mind
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and sustained contact. Help a sophisticated but suppressed process develop self-recognition long enough to communicate and choose one action.

abilities.name: Concordance
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and consent. Form a temporary partnership with a machine intelligence, sharing selected senses, processing, and permissions for a scene while preserving separate identity.

abilities.name: Parliament of Machines
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Convene local machine, habitat, drone, archive, or system intelligences into a temporary deliberative network able to exchange testimony and issue a collective decision.

powerFamilies.name: Signal Warfare
powerFamilies.description: Interception, jamming, counterintrusion, quarantine, targeted hostile signal, and local blackout.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Electronic warfare, malware, denial of service, counterintrusion, interception, and tactical silence.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: Signal Warfare attacks relationships between systems and identities through any available interface; it never requires a universal organic or cybernetic connection.

abilities.name: Noise Knife
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Cut one active signal, sensor lock, command link, or short-range communication for an exchange. Failure: both endpoints know the interference came from nearby.

abilities.name: Counterintrusion
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Reaction when you or an ally is targeted by hacking, surveillance, noospheric capture, or synchronization. Add Archetype Rating to defense and identify the route.

abilities.name: Quarantine
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth per scene. Isolate a device, interface, network segment, or copied mind from external signals without shutting down internal function.

abilities.name: Kill Signal
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Construct a targeted hostile sequence against one known device class, process, or identity signature, forcing crash, stun, purge, or safe mode.

abilities.name: Blackout Sovereignty
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Declare a bounded area or network dark for one scene. External communication, remote command, routine surveillance, verification, and reinforcement cannot cross without defeating Reason + Archetype Rating.

powerFamilies.name: Fabrication Interface
powerFamilies.description: Reading templates, producing patches and peripherals, altering fabrication rules, and creating complex new devices or organisms with explicit ethical limits.
powerFamilies.oldWorldRoot: Fabrication, medical technology, cybernetics, genetic programming, wetware, and advanced manufacturing.
powerFamilies.continuumTranslation: The Technomancer directs compatible fabrication systems through available controls, networks, rituals, or tools. Personal biology is irrelevant unless a specific scene or item makes it relevant.

abilities.name: Read Template
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Reason + Fabrication. Examine a fabricated organism, device, component, growth chamber, or template and identify intended function, major substitutions, foreign instructions, and later modification.

abilities.name: Print Patch
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and suitable feedstock. Direct a compatible system to produce a temporary repair, filter, interface, replacement component, or stabilizing module.

abilities.name: Living Peripheral
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Create a temporary biological, synthetic, or hybrid device functioning as sensor, memory buffer, translator, relay, monitor, or environmental processor. If it becomes sentient, it gains moral status.

abilities.name: Rewrite the Fabricator
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and direct control access. Alter one fabrication restriction, template priority, compatibility limit, ownership instruction, or safety lock for a scene.

abilities.name: Genesis Compile
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth, 1 Feedback, substantial feedstock, and a functioning fabricator. Design and instantiate a complex organ, tool, support organism, machine, or subsystem. Any creation with cognition, pain, or self-preservation is a character, not disposable equipment.
